[SWS_PHM_01350]
{DRAFT}
Switch Elementary Supervision Status from
kFAILED
to
kEXPIRED
⌈
If the
Elementary Supervision Status
is
kFAILED
AND if the
Alive Supervision
has a permanent failure, i.e. the counter for failed
Alive Supervision reference cycles exceeds failure tolerance
failedReferenceCy-
clesTolerance
, THEN the
Platform Health Management
shall change the
El-
ementary Supervision Status
to
kEXPIRED
and stop the corresponding super-
vision.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111)
See transition (6) in figure 7.5.
